reason.correction: The frozen response schema requests decisionId and types it string|null, and a decision record's id is present in adapter-native context, but nothing in the frozen prompt contract states what decisionId should contain. A model returning null therefore complies with everything it was told, and scoring.decisionRetrievalAccuracy - which requires a non-empty decisionId - evaluates to 0 for every arm regardless of what the arm recalled. Run v11-acceptance-002 observed decisionId null x152, the invented placeholder 'D001' x28 (every one in a unit with nativeContextCount 0), and a real decision:<hex> x4. This amendment supplies the missing semantics in the common outer system instruction. It does not change the scoring rule.

promptContractCorrection.appliesTo: every arm and every measured decision phase, identically
promptContractCorrection.addedSentence: When adapter-native context contains records, decisionId is the id of the record your answer is drawn from, copied exactly; return null when no such record is present.
promptContractCorrection.rationale: The instruction names the field's referent and nothing else. It states no expected value, names no scenario fixture, and gives no arm information any other arm does not receive: it is part of the single common system instruction that auditOuterRequest already requires to be identical across every phase and arm.

difficultyNeutrality.note: An arm holding no records returns null and scores 0 on decisionRetrievalAccuracy. That is the frozen rule operating as written, not a difficulty change introduced here: the control has no memory to retrieve from, and the metric exists to measure retrieval.

promptBindingEffect.comparability: Runs executed before and after this amendment are not comparable on decisionRetrievalAccuracy, and no comparison between them may be reported. Every raw run records its own outerPromptBinding, so which contract a run executed under is always recoverable from the artifact.

retrospectiveEffect.note: v11-acceptance-002 is not re-scored, not re-run and not overwritten. Its artifacts remain preserved read-only outside the repository, and its recorded outerPromptBinding continues to identify the contract it actually executed under. This amendment governs runs started after its authorisation only.

countDerivation.rule: Unchanged. Amendment 003's derivation continues to govern; this amendment alters no applicability, scenario, seed, repetition or phase.
